S-Class Technical Highlights:
Driver Assistance Systems: the enhanced intelligent hands-off detection includes sensing via finger pads and is sensitive to specific conditions; can be activated in a wider range of speeds:
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC ® is able to follow a vehicle in front at a pre-selected distance at wider range of speeds
Active Steering Assist functions at a wider range of speeds and can now actively intervene even if road lines are unclear or non-existent at certain speeds; can now function in curves with a tighter radius
Active Emergency Stop Assist brakes the vehicle to a standstill in its lane if it detects that the driver is no longer actively driving the vehicle while it is on the move with Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC and Active Steering Assist engaged. Can now unlock the doors when the vehicle is stationary to allow first aid responders immediate access to the vehicle's interior. With available mbrace® Secure, the system simultaneously makes an emergency call
Active Lane Change Assist is a radar-and-camera-based system that aids the driver when changing lanes. When a turn is indicated, this feature will aid with steering into the adjacent lane if it detects the lane is empty
Active Speed Limit Assist can adapt vehicle speed to identified speed limits and can now adjust preemptively when speed limits are going to change
Route-Based Speed Adaptation the vehicle is now able to reduce the speed in anticipatory mode by referencing the COMAND map data ahead of bends, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads.
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function
Evasive Steering Assist this system assists by adding calculated steering torque to aid in steering wheel movement when a driver deliberately or instinctively performs an evasive maneuver around a pedestrian
Active Blind Spot Assist is active at a wider range of speeds and informs the driver to help avoid an imminent side impact by single-sided braking
Active Lane Keeping Assist is active now at a wider range of speeds
Car-to-X communication is a system in which the vehicle simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to “see” much further down the road
PRE-SAFE ® PLUS activates the PRE-SAFE safety measures when a collision from behind is imminent
PRE-SAFE ® Sound omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the “stapedius reflex,” which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident
Touch Control Buttons are touch-sensitive controls on the steering wheel for easy control of the instrument cluster and multimedia system, similar to a smartphone interface, which responds to vertical and horizontal swiping movements
New generation of COMAND multimedia system with dual 12.3” high-resolution displays with single bonded glass panel
Energizing Comfort: enhanced health and wellness functionality boosts drivers’ attentiveness and well-being while reducing sleepiness and stress
AIR BODY CONTROL: available multi-chamber air suspension at all corners

The Mercedes-Benz S-Class is the flagship of the Mercedes-Benz range and arguable, the auto industry. With its upgrades for 2018, this model continues to lead the way in comfort, luxury and intelligence, which also include all safety and driver assistance systems. S-Class Technical Highlights:
Driver Assistance System: the enhanced intelligent hands-off detection includes sensing via Touch Control Buttons and is sensitive to specific conditions; can be activated in a wider range of speeds:
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC ® is able to follow a vehicle in front at a pre-selected distance at a wider range of speeds
Active Steering Assist functions at a wider range of speeds and can now actively intervene even if road lines are unclear or non-existent at certain speeds; can now function in curves with a tighter radius
Active Emergency Stop Assist brakes the vehicle to a standstill in its lane if it detects that the driver is no longer actively driving the vehicle while it is on the move with Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC and Active Steering Assist engaged. Can now unlock the doors when the vehicle is stationary to allow first responders immediate access to the vehicle's interior. With available mbrace® Secure, the system simultaneously makes an emergency call
Active Lane Change Assist aids the driver when changing lanes. When turn signal is activated , this feature will aid with steering into the adjacent lane if it detects the lane is empty
Active Speed Limit Assist can adapt vehicle speed to identified speed limits and can now adjust preemptively when speed limits are going to change
Route-Based Speed Adaptation is able to reduce the speed by referencing integrated map data ahead of bends, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads.
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to respond to crossing traffic, standing pedestrians and help bring the vehicle to a complete stop in order to eliminate or reduce impact severity
Evasive Steering Assist this system assists by adding calculated steering torque to aid in steering wheel movement when a driver deliberately or instinctively performs an evasive maneuver around a pedestrian in the vehicle’s path
Active Blind Spot Assist is active at a wider range of speeds and informs the driver to help avoid an imminent side impact by single-sided braking
Active Lane Keeping Assist is active now at a wider range of speeds to help keep the vehicle safely in its lane
Car-to-X Communication is a system in which the vehicle simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to “see" much further down the road
PRE-SAFE ® PLUS activates the PRE-SAFE safety measures when a collision from behind is imminent
PRE-SAFE ® Sound omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the “stapedius reflex," which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident
Touch Control Buttons are touch-sensitive controls on the steering wheel for easy control of the instrument cluster and multimedia system, similar to a smartphone interface, which responds to vertical and horizontal swiping movements
New generation of COMAND navigation system with dual 12.3" high-resolution displays within a single bonded glass panel
ENERGIZING Comfort: enhanced health and wellness functionality boosts drivers’ attentiveness and well-being while reducing drowsiness and stress
AIR BODY CONTROL: available multi-chamber air suspension at all corners

S-Class Technical Highlights:
Driver Assistance System: the enhanced intelligent hands-off detection includes sensing via Touch Control Buttons and is sensitive to specific conditions; can be activated in a wider range of speeds:
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC ® is able to follow a vehicle in front at a pre-selected distance at a wider range of speeds
Active Steering Assist functions at a wider range of speeds and can now actively intervene even if road lines are unclear or non-existent at certain speeds; can now function in curves with a tighter radius
Active Emergency Stop Assist brakes the vehicle to a standstill in its lane if it detects that the driver is no longer actively driving the vehicle while it is on the move with Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC and Active Steering Assist engaged. Can now unlock the doors when the vehicle is stationary to allow first responders immediate access to the vehicle's interior. With available mbrace® Secure, the system simultaneously makes an emergency call
Active Lane Change Assist aids the driver when changing lanes. When turn signal is activated , this feature will aid with steering into the adjacent lane if it detects the lane is empty
Active Speed Limit Assist can adapt vehicle speed to identified speed limits and can now adjust preemptively when speed limits are going to change
Route-Based Speed Adaptation is able to reduce the speed by referencing integrated map data ahead of bends, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads.
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to respond to crossing traffic, standing pedestrians and help bring the vehicle to a complete stop in order to eliminate or reduce impact severity
Evasive Steering Assist this system assists by adding calculated steering torque to aid in steering wheel movement when a driver deliberately or instinctively performs an evasive maneuver around a pedestrian in the vehicle’s path
Active Blind Spot Assist is active at a wider range of speeds and informs the driver to help avoid an imminent side impact by single-sided braking
Active Lane Keeping Assist is active now at a wider range of speeds to help keep the vehicle safely in its lane
Car-to-X Communication is a system in which the vehicle simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to “see" much further down the road
PRE-SAFE ® PLUS activates the PRE-SAFE safety measures when a collision from behind is imminent
PRE-SAFE ® Sound omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the “stapedius reflex," which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident
Touch Control Buttons are touch-sensitive controls on the steering wheel for easy control of the instrument cluster and multimedia system, similar to a smartphone interface, which responds to vertical and horizontal swiping movements
New generation of COMAND navigation system with dual 12.3" high-resolution displays within a single bonded glass panel
ENERGIZING Comfort: enhanced health and wellness functionality boosts drivers’ attentiveness and well-being while reducing drowsiness and stress
AIR BODY CONTROL: available multi-chamber air suspension at all corners
S-Class Model Positioning
The Mercedes-Benz S-Class Coupe is the highest expression of the Mercedes-Benz brand in a stunning pillarless coupe design; ultimate combination of premium luxury and performance with AMG models. The S-Class continues to lead the way in comfort, luxury and intelligence, which also include all safety, driver assistance and comfort systems. New generations of the latest Mercedes-Benz and AMG engines also complement the various models within the S-Class range.

S-Class Technical Highlights:
Driver Assistance System: the enhanced intelligent hands-off detection includes sensing via Touch Control Buttons and is sensitive to specific conditions; can be activated in a wider range of speeds:
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC ® is able to follow a vehicle in front at a pre-selected distance at a wider range of speeds
Active Steering Assist functions at a wider range of speeds and can now actively intervene even if road lines are unclear or non-existent at certain speeds; can now function in curves with a tighter radius
Active Emergency Stop Assist brakes the vehicle to a standstill in its lane if it detects that the driver is no longer actively driving the vehicle while it is on the move with Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC and Active Steering Assist engaged. Can now unlock the doors when the vehicle is stationary to allow first responders immediate access to the vehicle's interior. With available mbrace® Secure, the system simultaneously makes an emergency call
Active Lane Change Assist aids the driver when changing lanes. When turn signal is activated , this feature will aid with steering into the adjacent lane if it detects the lane is empty
Active Speed Limit Assist can adapt vehicle speed to identified speed limits and can now adjust preemptively when speed limits are going to change
Route-Based Speed Adaptation is able to reduce the speed by referencing integrated map data ahead of bends, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads.
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to respond to crossing traffic, standing pedestrians and help bring the vehicle to a complete stop in order to eliminate or reduce impact severity
Evasive Steering Assist this system assists by adding calculated steering torque to aid in steering wheel movement when a driver deliberately or instinctively performs an evasive maneuver around a pedestrian in the vehicle's path
Active Blind Spot Assist is active at a wider range of speeds and informs the driver to help avoid an imminent side impact by single-sided braking
Active Lane Keeping Assist is active now at a wider range of speeds to help keep the vehicle safely in its lane
Car-to-X Communication is a system in which the vehicle simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to "see" much further down the road
PRE-SAFE ® PLUS activates the PRE-SAFE safety measures when a collision from behind is imminent
PRE-SAFE ® Sound omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the "stapedius reflex," which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident
Touch Control Buttons are touch-sensitive controls on the steering wheel for easy control of the instrument cluster and multimedia system, similar to a smartphone interface, which responds to vertical and horizontal swiping movements
New generation of COMAND navigation system with dual 12.3" high-resolution displays within a single bonded glass panel
ENERGIZING Comfort: enhanced health and wellness functionality boosts drivers' attentiveness and well-being while reducing drowsiness and stress
AIR BODY CONTROL: available multi-chamber air suspension at all corners

Car-to-X communication is a system in which the vehicle simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to “see” much further down the road
PRE-SAFE ® PLUS activates the PRE-SAFE safety measures when a collision from behind is imminent
PRE-SAFE ® Sound omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the “stapedius reflex,” which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident
Touch Control Buttons are touch-sensitive controls on the steering wheel for easy control of the instrument cluster and multimedia system, similar to a smartphone interface, which responds to vertical and horizontal swiping movements
New generation of COMAND multimedia system with dual 12.3” high-resolution displays with single bonded glass panel
Energizing Comfort: enhanced health and wellness functionality boosts drivers’ attentiveness and well-being while reducing sleepiness and stress
AIR BODY CONTROL: available multi-chamber air suspension at all corners
S-Class Model Positioning
The Mercedes-Benz S-Class is the flagship of the Mercedes-Benz range and arguable, the auto industry. This model continues to lead the way in comfort, luxury and intelligence, which also include
all safety and driver assistance systems. New generations of the latest Mercedes-Benz and AMG engines also complement the various models within the S-Class range.
Maybach Model Positioning
The Mercedes-Maybach models extend the range of S-Class sedans to new benchmark in terms of exclusivity, offering more space and facilities for the highest demands.

S-Class Technical Highlights:
Driver Assistance System: the enhanced intelligent hands-off detection includes sensing via Touch Control Buttons and is sensitive to specific conditions; can be activated in a wider range of speeds:
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC ® is able to follow a vehicle in front at a pre-selected distance at a wider range of speeds
Active Steering Assist functions at a wider range of speeds and can now actively intervene even if road lines are unclear or non-existent at certain speeds; can now function in curves with a tighter radius
Active Emergency Stop Assist brakes the vehicle to a standstill in its lane if it detects that the driver is no longer actively driving the vehicle while it is on the move with Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC and Active Steering Assist engaged. Can now unlock the doors when the vehicle is stationary to allow first responders immediate access to the vehicle's interior. With available mbrace® Secure, the system simultaneously makes an emergency call
Active Lane Change Assist aids the driver when changing lanes. When turn signal is activated , this feature will aid with steering into the adjacent lane if it detects the lane is empty
Active Speed Limit Assist can adapt vehicle speed to identified speed limits and can now adjust preemptively when speed limits are going to change
Route-Based Speed Adaptation is able to reduce the speed by referencing integrated map data ahead of bends, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads.
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to respond to crossing traffic, standing pedestrians and help bring the vehicle to a complete stop in order to eliminate or reduce impact severity
Evasive Steering Assist this system assists by adding calculated steering torque to aid in steering wheel movement when a driver deliberately or instinctively performs an evasive maneuver around a pedestrian in the vehicle's path
Active Blind Spot Assist is active at a wider range of speeds and informs the driver to help avoid an imminent side impact by single-sided braking
Active Lane Keeping Assist is active now at a wider range of speeds to help keep the vehicle safely in its lane
Car-to-X Communication is a system in which the vehicle simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to "see" much further down the road
PRE-SAFE ® PLUS activates the PRE-SAFE safety measures when a collision from behind is imminent
PRE-SAFE ® Sound omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the "stapedius reflex," which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident
Touch Control Buttons are touch-sensitive controls on the steering wheel for easy control of the instrument cluster and multimedia system, similar to a smartphone interface, which responds to vertical and horizontal swiping movements
New generation of COMAND navigation system with dual 12.3" high-resolution displays within a single bonded glass panel
ENERGIZING Comfort: enhanced health and wellness functionality boosts drivers' attentiveness and well-being while reducing drowsiness and stress
AIR BODY CONTROL: available multi-chamber air suspension at all corners
Model Positioning
The Mercedes-Benz S-Class Cabriolet is the world's most comfortable convertible, offering a distinctive, sensual and exclusive design, the cutting-edge technology of the S-Class and a comprehensive warmth and wind protection concept that includes intelligent climate control for year- round enjoyment. The S-Class continues to lead the way in comfort, luxury and intelligence, which also include all safety, driver assistance and comfort systems. press-mbusa-s-class-2020-be661013.extract:
{"pdf_sha256": "be66101323468ccfaf3aead52d021c6f7208f1d8fb6ffe820d9d06e8a55fd665", "url": "https://media.mbusa.com/news/2020-s-class-coupe-quick-reference-guide", "pages": {"1": "2020 S-Class Coupe Quick Reference Guide
June 21, 2019
Models & MSRP

*Above prices exclude $995 delivery & destination charge
What’s New for MY20
Premium Package now standard inlcluding Active Multicontour front seats with massage, Surround View and front variable heated seats PLUS
AMG DRIVE UNIT newly available (AMG models)
AMG Aerodynamics Package newly available (AMG models)
S-Class Coupe Standard Equipment Highlights (S560 4M)
New generation of COMAND® navigation system with dual 12.3” high-resolution displays merged under a single bonded glass panel
3-spoke steering wheel with Touch Control Buttons
ENERGIZING Comfort
64-color ambient lighting
Inductive Wireless Charging
Lane Tracking Package
MULTIBEAM LED Intelligent Light System
Smartphone Integration with Apple CarPlay® and Android Auto
AMG S63 Coupe Standard Equipment Highlights
AMG Perfomance 4MATIC+® all-wheel drive with fully-variable torque distribution
LED Intelligent Light System
AMG DYNAMIC SELECT
RACE START function with simplified operating logic
AMG Multicontour Adaptive Sport Seats
New-generation three-spoke AMG Performance Steering Wheel
AMG SPEEDSHIFT® MCT 9-speed transmission
3-Stage ESP®
AMG Track Pace integrated with COMAND® system
AMG Performance Exhaust System
AMG Sport Suspension based on AIRMATIC®
Compound brake rotors (15.4” x 1.4” front / 14.2” x 0.9” rear) with 6-piston aluminum fixed calipers on the front axle and single-piston floating calipers on the rear
20” wheels
Optional Equipment Highlights
Latest-generation Driver Assistance System
AMG Line Exterior (S560 only)
AMG Optional Equipment Highlights
Forged 20” wheels in several unique designs
AMG Exterior options, including AMG Night Package, AMG Carbon Fiber Package, AMG Aerodynamics Package, and various interior upholsteries / trims
AMG High-Performance Ceramic Composite Braking System
S-Class Technical Highlights:
Driver Assistance System: the enhanced intelligent hands-off detection includes sensing via Touch Control Buttons and is sensitive to specific conditions; can be activated in a wider range of speeds:
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC ® is able to follow a vehicle in front at a pre-selected distance at a wider range of speeds
Active Steering Assist functions at a wider range of speeds and can now actively intervene even if road lines are unclear or non-existent at certain speeds; can now function in curves with a tighter radius
Active Emergency Stop Assist brakes the vehicle to a standstill in its lane if it detects that the driver is no longer actively driving the vehicle while it is on the move with Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC and Active Steering Assist engaged. Can now unlock the doors when the vehicle is stationary to allow first responders immediate access to the vehicle's interior. With available mbrace® Secure, the system simultaneously makes an emergency call
Active Lane Change Assist aids the driver when changing lanes. When turn signal is activated , this feature will aid with steering into the adjacent lane if it detects the lane is empty
Active Speed Limit Assist can adapt vehicle speed to identified speed limits and can now adjust preemptively when speed limits are going to change
Route-Based Speed Adaptation is able to reduce the speed by referencing integrated map data ahead of bends, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads.
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to respond to crossing traffic, standing pedestrians and help bring the vehicle to a complete stop in order to eliminate or reduce impact severity
Evasive Steering Assist this system assists by adding calculated steering torque to aid in steering wheel movement when a driver deliberately or instinctively performs an evasive maneuver around a pedestrian in the vehicle’s path
Active Blind Spot Assist is active at a wider range of speeds and informs the driver to help avoid an imminent side impact by single-sided braking
Active Lane Keeping Assist is active now at a wider range of speeds to help keep the vehicle safely in its lane
Car-to-X Communication is a system in which the vehicle simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to “see” much further down the road
PRE-SAFE ® PLUS activates the PRE-SAFE safety measures when a collision from behind is imminent
PRE-SAFE ® Sound omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the “stapedius reflex,” which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident
Touch Control Buttons are touch-sensitive controls on the steering wheel for easy control of the instrument cluster and multimedia system, similar to a smartphone interface, which responds to vertical and horizontal swiping movements
New generation of COMAND navigation system with dual 12.3” high-resolution displays within a single bonded glass panel
ENERGIZING Comfort: enhanced health and wellness functionality boosts drivers’ attentiveness and well-being while reducing drowsiness and stress
AIR BODY CONTROL: available multi-chamber air suspension at all corners
Model Positioning
The Mercedes-Benz S-Class Coupe is the highest expression of the Mercedes-Benz brand in a stunning pillarless coupe design; ultimate combination of premium luxury and performance with AMG models. The S-Class continues to lead the way in comfort, luxury and intelligence, which also include all safety, driver assistance and comfort systems. New generations of the latest Mercedes-Benz and AMG engines also complement the various models within the S-Class range.

September 2, 2020

What's New

S-Class Technical Feature Highlights
OLED (Organic Light Emitting Diode) Screen (standard): In the S-Class, the OLED display is located behind a glass facing, and in combination with the actuators and pressure sensors behind it, provides a comprehensive control and display experience. Evaluation of the pressure exerted and haptic confirmation of touch commands makes extended functionalities possible. Furthermore, OLED panels emit light when subjected to an electric current, and do not require external background lighting, so power is only consumed where pixels light up, ensuring a better black level and even stronger contrast. When showing typical video sequences, OLED technology has up to 30 percent lower energy consumption than LCD technology.
Burmester® High-End 4D Surround Sound System (available) : This unique 4D experience uses speaker-like resonators featuring sound massage with surround speakers integrated into the seats, and clear voice reproduction. The system is equipped with 30 high-end speakers, all with their own amplifier channel with digital and analogue filters producing a total output of up to 1,750 watts, including an amplifier with an output of 400 watts for the subwoofer bass speaker in the trunk. The 4D experience includes a sound personalization function for sound reproduction, VIP seat function to optimize the sound for individual seats along with multichannel audio formats and five different sound profiles including: Pure, Live, Easy Listening, Surround and 3D-Sound.
Rear-Axle Steering (available): With available rear-axle steering, the S-Class is as maneuverable as a compact car. The steering angle at the rear axle is up to 4.5 or 10 degrees, allowing impressive maneuverability and agility on narrow city streets. At the same time the handling benefits from a virtual extension of the wheelbase at higher speeds:
With all-wheel steering and the 10-degree steering angle at the rear, the turning radius of the S-Class is reduced by up to 7 feet. This gives the long-wheelbase S-Class a turning circle of less than 36 feet.
This extraordinary maneuverability and agility is also achieved by combining the rear-axle steering with a more direct front-axle steering ratio.
Integrated actuation of the steering and brakes makes handling even more precise and stable in dynamic situations.
48-Volt on-board electrical system technology with EQ Boost (standard): The engines found in the S 500 4MATIC and S 580 4MATIC are supplemented with a powerful and efficient Integrated Starter Generator. This integrated electric motor system, known as EQ Boost, assists the combustion engine by adding up to 21 hp for short periods of time. EQ Boost also assists when accelerating, making driving without the combustion engine turned on possible ("sailing") and supplies the battery with power by means of high-efficiency recuperation. By doing so, it makes fuel savings possible that were previously the exclusive domain of high-voltage hybrid technology.
Mercedes-Benz User Experience (MBUX; standard): A revolutionary multimedia system featuring innovative technology based on Artificial Intelligence and an intuitive operating system. MBUX is pioneering a new level of in-car experience. The system can be operated by a new generation of Voice Control, the center touchscreen, and/or by the Touch Control Buttons on the steering wheel. The system has learning capabilities and intelligent Voice Control with Natural Language Understanding and a verbal cue of "Hey Mercedes."
Augmented Video for Navigation (standard): When the navigation function is active, a video image of the surroundings is enhanced with arrows or house numbers automatically superimposed directly onto the image in the media display.
Augmented Reality Head-Up Display (AR-HUD; available): Augmented Reality for Head- Up Display further supplements MBUX and Augmented Video for Navigation with driver assistance systems and navigation information by generating and projecting images in the Head-Up Display, directly in the driver's field of vision.
3D Instrument Cluster (available): Three-dimensional warnings and functions of the driver assistance systems are immediately noticeable with striking 3D and shaded effects, such as 3D images of cars, trucks, buses or motorcycles surrounding the vehicle.
ENERGIZING Comfort (available): enhanced health and wellness system boosts drivers' attentiveness and well-being while reducing sleepiness and stress through available programs that intelligently combine comfort and vehicle functions such as climate control and lighting.
Driver Assistance Systems (all systems standard): The S-Class is standard-equipped with the latest driver assistance technology including intelligent hands-off detection. The Driver Assistance Package includes:
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC® is an adaptive cruise control system that is able to automatically adjust your set speed for traffic ahead.
with Route-Based Speed Adaptation: the vehicle is able to reduce the speed in anticipatory mode by referencing map data ahead of curves, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads.
Active Stop-and-Go Assist is able to keep the vehicle within the lane and maintain a safe distance with a high level of availability at speeds up to 35 mph. With the extended restart function, the vehicle can restart automatically up to one minute after coming to a stop.
Active Steering Assist generates steering torque which helps the driver to stay in the center of the lane on straight roads and slight bends, taking its guidance from vehicles ahead and lane markings
with Active Emergency Stop Assist : brakes the vehicle to a stop in a controlled manner when the system recognizes that the driver is distracted for a longer period or cannot intervene.
and Active Lane Change Assist : assists the driver in a convenient and cooperative manner when making lane changes.
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to help the driver avoid impending collisions with vehicles ahead, or when turning across the oncoming lane, the system will also assist with stationary or crossing vehicles and pedestrians, if the driver fails to take action quickly enough.
Turn-off function of Active Brake Assist: activation of Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Assist when turning across the opposite lane. If there is a risk of collision when turning across the path of oncoming vehicles, the vehicle will be braked when traveling at low speeds.
Active Speed Limit Assist with Traffic Sign Assist utilizes map data and information from Traffic Sign Assist to automatically adapt the vehicle's speed.
Active Blind Spot Assist is able to provide the driver with a visual alert, plus an audible alarm when a turn indicator is activated, to warn the driver if another vehicle is detected in the blind spot area. It can also help avoid a collision by single-sided braking if a lane change is still attempted with an obstacle in the blind spot.
with Exit Warning: offers enhanced protection when getting out of the car, a visual warning for passengers displayed in the exterior mirror if a car or bicycle is driving past the vehicle. If the driver tries to open the door, an additional audible warning sound and ambient door lighting will start to flash red.
Active Lane Keeping Assist is able to warn the driver by means of vibrations of the steering wheel when the vehicle is unintentionally drifting out of its lane. If the vehicle passes over a solid line, or a dashed line when opposing traffic is detected, this system can pull the vehicle back into its lane by applying the brakes on one side.
Car-to-X Communication is a system in which the vehicle simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to "see" much further down the road.
Active Parking Assist with PARTRONIC and 360° camera make it possible to enter and leave parallel and end-on parking spaces automatically.
PRE-SAFE® PLUS with PRE-SAFE® Sound activates the PRE-SAFE safety measures when a collision from behind is imminent as well as applying the brakes when the vehicle is at a standstill in order to prevent subsequent accidents. PRE-SAFE® Sound omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the "stapedius reflex," which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident.
PRE-SAFE® Impulse Side preventatively moves the driver or front passenger up to 2.75- inches away from the impact zone to the side by rapidly inflating the seat's side bolster, reducing the load on the occupant during an accident if a lateral collision is detected by the system.
Rear Passenger Airbag (available): Cylindrical, tubular structures are inflated with compressed gas and deploy a wing-shaped structure. A large, tent-like airbag deploys between the two wings, and this is inflated by the surrounding air via specially patented valves in the skin. This takes place with comparatively low force and a low risk of injury, as the tubular wings give way to obstacles. The airbag enhances the restraining effect of the belt system, and can support the head and neck to decrease the loads on them significantly.
Toll Gate Transponder (standard): With a payment account set up via the Mercedes me Connect app, the built-in toll gate transponder will work with all major toll roads in the U.S. and select airport parking structures.
MAGIC VISION CONTROL (standard): This innovative and highly efficient windscreen wiper system ensures greater visibility and greater safety by adjusting the water quantity to the situation by taking into account the ambient temperature, vehicle speed and other factors to spray washer fluid directly onto the windscreen in front of the wiper blades, precisely where it is required.
Model Positioning
The Mercedes-Benz S-Class is the flagship of the Mercedes-Benz model range, representing a seamless combination of luxurious form and intelligent function thoughtfully executed down to the smallest detail. The S-Class consistently embodies the brand's very best thinking, with human- centered innovations supported by 135 years of automotive expertise delivering unparalleled levels of comfort, refinement and tailored craftsmanship. The launch of every new S-Class represents an important milestone for Mercedes-Benz. This next generation S-Class is poised to take comfort, safety and the overall driver and passenger experience to a completely new level and set new standards not only for the company, but for the industry as a whole.

MBUX High-End Rear Seat Entertainment system with MBUX rear tablet, two wireless headsets and two integrated high-resolution 11.6” touchscreens with full-HD camera and microphone, allowing each user to integrate their own media through various interfaces, creating a personalized experience with the option to interact and share content with other passengers
Warmth & Comfort Package with Heated Steering Wheel, Heated Front and Rear Armrests, Rear Seat Heating, Electronic and Memory Rear Seats and Energizing Comfort health and wellness system that boosts drivers’ attentiveness and well-being while reducing sleepiness and stress
Maybach Sedan Optional Feature Highlights
10 Maybach-exclusive two-tone paint options
Executive Rear Seat Plus, including:
First-Class rear compartment with 4-seat configuration, continuous, electric rear center console, two folding tables, two temperature-controlled cup holders, illuminated stowage compartment with 12V socket, wood trim with Maybach-emblem underneath the head rack, two additional USB ports and two HDMI ports
Electronically-operated comfort rear doors
Refrigerated compartment
Champagne flutes and champagne flute holders
Maybach Sedan Technical Feature Highlights
OLED (Organic Light Emitting Diode) Screen (standard): In the Maybach, the OLED display is located behind a glass facing, in combination with the actuators and pressure sensors behind it that provide a comprehensive control and display experience. Evaluation of the pressure exerted and haptic confirmation of touch commands makes extended functionalities possible. Furthermore, OLED panels emit light when subjected to an electric current, and do not require external background lighting, so power is only consumed where pixels light up, ensuring a better black level and even stronger contrast. When showing typical video sequences, OLED technology has up to 30 percent lower energy consumption than LCD technology.
Burmester® High-End 4D Surround Sound System (standard) : This unique 4D experience uses speaker-like resonators featuring sound massage with surround speakers integrated into the seats, and clear voice reproduction. The system is equipped with 30 high-end speakers, all with their own amplifier channel with digital and analogue filters producing a total output of up to 1,750 watts, including an amplifier with an output of 400 watts for the subwoofer bass speaker in the trunk. The 4D experience includes a sound personalization function for sound reproduction, VIP seat function to optimize the sound for individual seats along with multichannel audio formats and five different sound profiles including: Pure, Live, Easy Listening, Surround and 3D-Sound.
Rear-Axle Steering (standard): The steering angle at the rear axle is up to 4.5 or 10 degrees depending on the wheel selection (staggered or non-staggered), allowing impressive maneuverability and agility on narrow city streets. At the same time the handling benefits from a virtual extension of the wheelbase at higher speeds:
The turning radius of the Maybach S-Class is reduced by up to 7 feet (almost two meters).
This extraordinary maneuverability and agility is also achieved by combining the rear-axle steering with a more direct front-axle steering ratio.
Integrated actuation of the steering and brakes makes handling even more precise and stable in dynamic situations.
48-Volt on-board electrical system technology with EQ Boost (standard): The engine found in the Mercedes-Maybach S 580 4MATIC is supplemented with a powerful and efficient Integrated Starter Generator. This integrated electric motor system, known as EQ Boost, assists the combustion engine by adding up to 21 hp for short periods of time. EQ Boost also assists when accelerating, making driving without the combustion engine turned on possible ("sailing") and supplies the battery with power by means of high-efficiency recuperation. By doing so, it makes fuel savings possible that were previously the exclusive domain of high-voltage hybrid technology.
Mercedes-Benz User Experience (MBUX; standard): A revolutionary multimedia system featuring innovative technology based on Artificial Intelligence and an intuitive operating system. MBUX is pioneering a new level of in-car experience. The system can be operated by a new generation of Voice Control, the center touchscreen, and/or by the Touch Control Buttons on the steering wheel. The system has learning capabilities and intelligent Voice Control with Natural Language Understanding and a verbal cue of “Hey Mercedes.”
Augmented Video for Navigation (standard): When the navigation function is active, a video image of the surroundings is enhanced with arrows or house numbers automatically superimposed directly onto the image in the media display.
Augmented Reality Head-Up Display (AR-HUD; standard): Augmented Reality for Head-Up Display further supplements MBUX and Augmented Video for Navigation with driver assistance systems and navigation information by generating and projecting images in the Head-Up Display, directly in the driver’s field of vision.
3D Instrument Cluster (standard): Three-dimensional warnings and functions of the driver assistance systems are immediately noticeable with striking 3D and shaded effects, such as 3D images of cars, trucks, buses or motorcycles surrounding the vehicle.
ENERGIZING Comfort (standard): enhanced health and wellness system boosts drivers’ attentiveness and well-being while reducing sleepiness and stress through available programs that intelligently combine comfort and vehicle functions such as climate control and lighting.
Driver Assistance Systems (all systems standard): The Maybach is standard-equipped with the latest driver assistance technology including intelligent hands-off detection. The Driver Assistance Package includes:
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC® is an adaptive cruise control system that is able to automatically adjust your set speed for traffic ahead.
with Route-Based Speed Adaptation: the vehicle is able to reduce the speed in anticipatory mode by referencing map data ahead of curves, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads.
Active Stop-and-Go Assist is able to keep the vehicle within the lane and maintain a safe distance with a high level of availability at speeds up to 35 mph. With the extended restart function, the vehicle can restart automatically up to one minute after coming to a stop.
Active Steering Assist generates steering torque which helps the driver to stay in the center of the lane on straight roads and slight bends, taking its guidance from vehicles ahead and lane markings
with Active Emergency Stop Assist : brakes the vehicle to a stop in a controlled manner when the system recognizes that the driver is distracted for a longer period or cannot intervene.
and Active Lane Change Assist : assists the driver in a convenient and cooperative manner when making lane changes.
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to help the driver avoid impending collisions with vehicles ahead, or when turning across the oncoming lane, the system will also assist with stationary or crossing vehicles and pedestrians, if the driver fails to take action quickly enough.
Turn-off function of Active Brake Assist: activation of Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Assist when turning across the opposite lane. If there is a risk of collision when turning across the path of oncoming vehicles, the vehicle will be braked when traveling at low speeds.
Active Speed Limit Assist with Traffic Sign Assist utilizes map data and information from Traffic Sign Assist to automatically adapt the vehicle's speed.
Active Blind Spot Assist is able to provide the driver with a visual alert, plus an audible alarm when a turn indicator is activated, to warn the driver if another vehicle is detected in the blind spot area. It can also help avoid a collision by single-sided braking if a lane change is still attempted with an obstacle in the blind spot.
with Exit Warning: offers enhanced protection when getting out of the car, a visual warning for passengers displayed in the exterior mirror if a car or bicycle is driving past the vehicle. If the driver tries to open the door, an additional audible warning sound and ambient door lighting will start to flash red.
Active Lane Keeping Assist is able to warn the driver by means of vibrations of the steering wheel when the vehicle is unintentionally drifting out of its lane. If the vehicle passes over a solid line, or a dashed line when opposing traffic is detected, this system can pull the vehicle back into its lane by applying the brakes on one side.
Car-to-X Communication is a system in which the vehicle simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to “see” much further down the road.
Active Parking Assist with PARTRONIC and 360° camera make it possible to enter and leave parallel and end-on parking spaces automatically.
PRE-SAFE® PLUS with PRE-SAFE® Sound activates the PRE-SAFE safety measures when a collision from behind is imminent as well as applying the brakes when the vehicle is at a standstill in order to prevent subsequent accidents. PRE-SAFE® Sound emits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the “stapedius reflex,” which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident.
PRE-SAFE® Impulse Side preventatively moves the driver or front passenger up to 2.75- inches away from the impact zone to the side by rapidly inflating the seat’s side bolster, reducing the load on the occupant during an accident if a lateral collision is detected by the system.
Rear Airbag (standard): Cylindrical, tubular structures are inflated with compressed gas and deploy a wing-shaped structure. A large, tent-like airbag deploys between the two wings, and this is inflated by the surrounding air via specially patented valves in the skin. This takes place with comparatively low force and a low risk of injury, as the tubular wings give way to obstacles. The airbag enhances the restraining effect of the belt system, and can support the head and neck to decrease the loads on them significantly.
Toll Gate Transponder (standard): With a payment account set up via the Mercedes me Connect app, the built-in toll gate transponder will work with all major toll roads in the U.S. and select airport parking structures.
MAGIC VISION CONTROL (standard): This innovative and highly efficient windscreen wiper system ensures greater visibility and greater safety by adjusting the water quantity to the situation by taking into account the ambient temperature, vehicle speed and other factors to spray washer fluid directly onto the windscreen in front of the wiper blades, precisely where it is required.
Model Positioning
The Mercedes-Maybach brand represents the manifestation of sophisticated luxury in its most advanced form. The new-generation Mercedes-Maybach S-Class demonstrates an elegant combination of sublime beauty, refinement and tailored craftsmanship, alongside its industry-leading innovations in terms of intelligent drive, connectivity and driving comfort. This dedication to the highest form of status and style is apparent in the exceptional design of Mercedes-Maybach models: from supreme quality material and carefully hand-painted colors, to highly exclusive and Maybach-specific design elements and features that underline the Mercedes-Maybach sedan as the absolute pinnacle of sophisticated luxury.

S-Class Technical Feature Highlights
OLED (Organic Light Emitting Diode) Screen (standard): In the S-Class, the OLED display is located behind a glass facing, and in combination with the actuators and pressure sensors behind it, provides a comprehensive control and display experience. Evaluation of the pressure exerted and haptic confirmation of touch commands makes extended functionalities possible. Furthermore, OLED panels emit light when subjected to an electric current, and do not require external background lighting, so power is only consumed where pixels light up, ensuring a better black level and even stronger contrast. When showing typical video sequences, OLED technology has up to 30 percent lower energy consumption than LCD technology.
Burmester® High-End 4D Surround Sound System (available) : This unique 4D experience uses speaker-like resonators featuring sound massage with surround speakers integrated into the seats, and clear voice reproduction. The system is equipped with 30 high-end speakers, all with their own amplifier channel with digital and analogue filters producing a total output of up to 1,750 watts, including an amplifier with an output of 400 watts for the subwoofer bass speaker in the trunk. The 4D experience includes a sound personalization function for sound reproduction, VIP seat function to optimize the sound for individual seats along with multichannel audio formats and five different sound profiles including: Pure, Live, Easy Listening, Surround and 3D-Sound.
Rear-Axle Steering (available): With available rear-axle steering, the S-Class is as maneuverable as a compact car. The steering angle at the rear axle is up to 4.5 or 10 degrees, allowing impressive maneuverability and agility on narrow city streets. At the same time the handling benefits from a virtual extension of the wheelbase at higher speeds:
With all-wheel steering and the 10-degree steering angle at the rear, the turning radius of the S- Class is reduced by up to 7 feet. This gives the long-wheelbase S-Class a turning circle of less than 36 feet.
This extraordinary maneuverability and agility is also achieved by combining the rear-axle steering with a more direct front-axle steering ratio.
Integrated actuation of the steering and brakes makes handling even more precise and stable in dynamic situations.
48-Volt on-board electrical system technology with EQ Boost (standard): The engines found in the S 500 4MATIC and S 580 4MATIC are supplemented with a powerful and efficient Integrated Starter Generator. This integrated electric motor system, known as EQ Boost, assists the combustion engine by adding up to 21 hp for short periods of time. EQ Boost also assists when accelerating, making driving without the combustion engine turned on possible ("sailing") and supplies the battery with power by means of high-efficiency recuperation. By doing so, it makes fuel savings possible that were previously the exclusive domain of high-voltage hybrid technology.
Mercedes-Benz User Experience (MBUX; standard): A revolutionary multimedia system featuring innovative technology based on Artificial Intelligence and an intuitive operating system. MBUX is pioneering a new level of in-car experience. The system can be operated by a new generation of Voice Control, the center touchscreen, and/or by the Touch Control Buttons on the steering wheel. The system has learning capabilities and intelligent Voice Control with Natural Language Understanding and a verbal cue of "Hey Mercedes."
Augmented Video for Navigation (standard): When the navigation function is active, a video image of the surroundings is enhanced with arrows or house numbers automatically superimposed directly onto the image in the media display.
Augmented Reality Head-Up Display (AR-HUD; available): Augmented Reality for Head-Up Display further supplements MBUX and Augmented Video for Navigation with driver assistance systems and navigation information by generating and projecting images in the Head-Up Display, directly in the driver's field of vision.
3D Instrument Cluster (available): Three-dimensional warnings and functions of the driver assistance systems are immediately noticeable with striking 3D and shaded effects, such as 3D images of cars, trucks, buses or motorcycles surrounding the vehicle.
ENERGIZING Comfort (available): enhanced health and wellness system boosts drivers' attentiveness and well-being while reducing sleepiness and stress through available programs that intelligently combine comfort and vehicle functions such as climate control and lighting.
Driver Assistance Systems (all systems standard): The S-Class is standard-equipped with the latest driver assistance technology including intelligent hands-off detection. The Driver Assistance Package includes:
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC® is an adaptive cruise control system that is able to automatically adjust your set speed for traffic ahead.
with Route-Based Speed Adaptation: the vehicle is able to reduce the speed in anticipatory mode by referencing map data ahead of curves, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads.
Active Stop-and-Go Assist is able to keep the vehicle within the lane and maintain a safe distance with a high level of availability at speeds up to 35 mph. With the extended restart function, the vehicle can restart automatically up to one minute after coming to a stop.
Active Steering Assist generates steering torque which helps the driver to stay in the center of the lane on straight roads and slight bends, taking its guidance from vehicles ahead and lane markings
with Active Emergency Stop Assist : brakes the vehicle to a stop in a controlled manner when the system recognizes that the driver is distracted for a longer period or cannot intervene.
and Active Lane Change Assist : assists the driver in a convenient and cooperative manner when making lane changes.
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to help the driver avoid impending collisions with vehicles ahead, or when turning across the oncoming lane, the system will also assist with stationary or crossing vehicles and pedestrians, if the driver fails to take action quickly enough.
Turn-off function of Active Brake Assist: activation of Active Brake Assist with Cross- Traffic Assist when turning across the opposite lane. If there is a risk of collision when turning across the path of oncoming vehicles, the vehicle will be braked when traveling at low speeds.
Active Speed Limit Assist with Traffic Sign Assist utilizes map data and information from Traffic Sign Assist to automatically adapt the vehicle's speed.
Active Blind Spot Assist is able to provide the driver with a visual alert, plus an audible alarm when a turn indicator is activated, to warn the driver if another vehicle is detected in the blind spot area. It can also help avoid a collision by single-sided braking if a lane change is still attempted with an obstacle in the blind spot.
with Exit Warning: offers enhanced protection when getting out of the car, a visual warning for passengers displayed in the exterior mirror if a car or bicycle is driving past the vehicle. If the driver tries to open the door, an additional audible warning sound and ambient door lighting will start to flash red.
Active Lane Keeping Assist is able to warn the driver by means of vibrations of the steering wheel when the vehicle is unintentionally drifting out of its lane. If the vehicle passes over a solid line, or a dashed line when opposing traffic is detected, this system can pull the vehicle back into its lane by applying the brakes on one side.
Car-to-X Communication is a system in which the vehicle simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to "see" much further down the road.
Active Parking Assist with PARTRONIC and 360° camera make it possible to enter and leave parallel and end-on parking spaces automatically.
PRE-SAFE® PLUS with PRE-SAFE® Sound activates the PRE-SAFE safety measures when a collision from behind is imminent as well as applying the brakes when the vehicle is at a standstill in order to prevent subsequent accidents. PRE-SAFE® Sound emits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the "stapedius reflex," which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident.
PRE-SAFE® Impulse Side preventatively moves the driver or front passenger up to 2.75-inches away from the impact zone to the side by rapidly inflating the seat's side bolster, reducing the load on the occupant during an accident if a lateral collision is detected by the system.
Rear Passenger Airbag (available): Cylindrical, tubular structures are inflated with compressed gas and deploy a wing-shaped structure. A large, tent-like airbag deploys between the two wings, and this is inflated by the surrounding air via specially patented valves in the skin. This takes place with comparatively low force and a low risk of injury, as the tubular wings give way to obstacles. The airbag enhances the restraining effect of the belt system, and can support the head and neck to decrease the loads on them significantly.
Toll Gate Transponder (standard): With a payment account set up via the Mercedes me Connect app, the built-in toll gate transponder will work with all major toll roads in the U.S. and select airport parking structures.
MAGIC VISION CONTROL (standard): This innovative and highly efficient windscreen wiper system ensures greater visibility and greater safety by adjusting the water quantity to the situation by taking into account the ambient temperature, vehicle speed and other factors to spray washer fluid directly onto the windscreen in front of the wiper blades, precisely where it is required.
Model Positioning
The Mercedes-Benz S-Class is the flagship of the Mercedes-Benz model range, representing a seamless combination of luxurious form and intelligent function thoughtfully executed down to the smallest detail. The S-Class consistently embodies the brand's very best thinking, with human-centered innovations supported by 135 years of automotive expertise delivering unparalleled levels of comfort, refinement and tailored craftsmanship. The launch of every new S-Class represents an important milestone for Mercedes- Benz. This next generation S-Class is poised to take comfort, safety and the overall driver and passenger experience to a completely new level and set new standards not only for the company, but for the industry as a whole.

48-Volt on-board electrical system technology with Integrated Starter Generator (standard): The engines found in the S 500 4MATIC and S 580 4MATIC are supplemented with a powerful and efficient Integrated Starter Generator. This integrated electric motor system assists the combustion engine by adding up to 21 hp for short periods of time. It also assists when accelerating, making driving without the combustion engine turned on possible ("sailing") and supplies the battery with power by means of high- efficiency recuperation. By doing so, it makes fuel savings possible that were previously the exclusive domain of high-voltage hybrid technology.
E-ACTIVE BODY CONTROL (available): Adds semi-supporting hydropneumatics to the air suspension. The air springs bear the base load of the vehicle body and gradually regulate the level. The hydropneumatics generate dynamic forces that overlay the air suspension forces, and actively support and dampen the vehicle body. At each wheel, a damper is installed within the axle whose two working chambers have an adjustable damping valve and a hydraulic pressure reservoir. The damper is connected to an intelligent motor/pump unit in the 48 V network by hydraulic lines. Actuation of the motor/pump unit enables the hydraulic fluid to be displaced to create a difference in pressure within the damper, allowing an active force to be generated. The motor/pump units at all four wheels are coordinated by a central control unit which also actuates the valves and the compressor for the air springs, and therefore always controls the entire suspension system.
Mercedes-Benz User Experience (MBUX; standard): A revolutionary multimedia system featuring innovative technology based on Artificial Intelligence and an intuitive operating system. MBUX is pioneering a new level of in-car experience. The system can be operated by a new generation of Voice Control, the center touchscreen, and/or by the Touch Control Buttons on the steering wheel. The system has learning capabilities and intelligent Voice Control with Natural Language Understanding and a verbal cue of "Hey Mercedes."
Augmented Video for Navigation (standard): When the navigation function is active, a video image of the surroundings is enhanced with arrows or house numbers automatically superimposed directly onto the image in the media display.
Augmented Reality Head-Up Display (AR-HUD; available): Augmented Reality for Head-Up Display further supplements MBUX and Augmented Video for Navigation with driver assistance systems and navigation information by generating and projecting images in the Head-Up Display, directly in the driver's field of vision.
3D Instrument Cluster (available): Three-dimensional warnings and functions of the driver assistance systems are immediately noticeable with striking 3D and shaded effects, such as 3D images of cars, trucks, buses or motorcycles surrounding the vehicle.
ENERGIZING Comfort (available): enhanced health and wellness system boosts drivers' attentiveness and well-being while reducing sleepiness and stress through available programs that intelligently combine comfort and vehicle functions such as climate control and lighting.
Driver Assistance Systems (all systems standard): The S-Class is standard-equipped with the latest driver assistance technology including intelligent hands-off detection. The Driver Assistance Package includes:
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC® is an adaptive cruise control system that is able to automatically adjust your set speed for traffic ahead.
with Route-Based Speed Adaptation: the vehicle is able to reduce the speed in anticipatory mode by referencing map data ahead of curves, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads.
Active Stop-and-Go Assist is able to keep the vehicle within the lane and maintain a safe distance with a high level of availability at speeds up to 35 mph. With the extended restart function, the vehicle can restart automatically up to one minute after coming to a stop.
Active Steering Assist generates steering torque which helps the driver to stay in the center of the lane on straight roads and slight bends, taking its guidance from vehicles ahead and lane markings
with Active Emergency Stop Assist : brakes the vehicle to a stop in a controlled manner when the system recognizes that the driver is distracted for a longer period or cannot intervene.
and Active Lane Change Assist : assists the driver in a convenient and cooperative manner when making lane changes.
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to help the driver avoid impending collisions with vehicles ahead, or when turning across the oncoming lane, the system will also assist with stationary or crossing vehicles and pedestrians, if the driver fails to take action quickly enough.
Turn-off function of Active Brake Assist: activation of Active Brake Assist with Cross- Traffic Assist when turning across the opposite lane. If there is a risk of collision when turning across the path of oncoming vehicles, the vehicle will be braked when traveling at low speeds.
Active Speed Limit Assist with Traffic Sign Assist utilizes map data and information from Traffic Sign Assist to automatically adapt the vehicle's speed.
Active Blind Spot Assist is able to provide the driver with a visual alert, plus an audible alarm when a turn indicator is activated, to warn the driver if another vehicle is detected in the blind spot area. It can also help avoid a collision by single-sided braking if a lane change is still attempted with an obstacle in the blind spot.
with Exit Warning: offers enhanced protection when getting out of the car, a visual warning for passengers displayed in the exterior mirror if a car or bicycle is driving past the vehicle. If the driver tries to open the door, an additional audible warning sound and ambient door lighting will start to flash red.
Active Lane Keeping Assist is able to warn the driver by means of vibrations of the steering wheel when the vehicle is unintentionally drifting out of its lane. If the vehicle passes over a solid line, or a dashed line when opposing traffic is detected, this system can pull the vehicle back into its lane by applying the brakes on one side.
Car-to-X Communication is a system in which the vehicle simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to "see" much further down the road.
Active Parking Assist with PARTRONIC and 360° camera make it possible to enter and leave parallel and end-on parking spaces automatically.
PRE-SAFE® PLUS with PRE-SAFE® Sound activates the PRE-SAFE safety measures when a collision from behind is imminent as well as applying the brakes when the vehicle is at a standstill in order to prevent subsequent accidents. PRE-SAFE® Sound emits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the "stapedius reflex," which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident.
PRE-SAFE® Impulse Side preventatively moves the driver or front passenger up to 2.75-inches away from the impact zone to the side by rapidly inflating the seat's side bolster, reducing the load on the occupant during an accident if a lateral collision is detected by the system.
Rear Passenger Airbag (available): Cylindrical, tubular structures are inflated with compressed gas and deploy a wing-shaped structure. A large, tent-like airbag deploys between the two wings, and this is inflated by the surrounding air via specially patented valves in the skin. This takes place with comparatively low force and a low risk of injury, as the tubular wings give way to obstacles. The airbag enhances the restraining effect of the belt system, and can support the head and neck to decrease the loads on them significantly.
Toll Gate Transponder (standard): With a payment account set up via the Mercedes me Connect app, the built-in toll gate transponder will work with all major toll roads in the U.S. and select airport parking structures.
MAGIC VISION CONTROL (standard): This innovative and highly efficient windscreen wiper system ensures greater visibility and greater safety by adjusting the water quantity to the situation by taking into account the ambient temperature, vehicle speed and other factors to spray washer fluid directly onto the windscreen in front of the wiper blades, precisely where it is required.
Model Positioning
The Mercedes-Benz S-Class is the flagship of the Mercedes-Benz model range, representing a seamless combination of luxurious form and intelligent function thoughtfully executed down to the smallest detail. The S-Class consistently embodies the brand's very best thinking, with human-centered innovations supported by 135 years of automotive expertise delivering unparalleled levels of comfort, refinement and tailored craftsmanship. The launch of every new S-Class represents an important milestone for Mercedes- Benz. This next generation S-Class is poised to take comfort, safety and the overall driver and passenger experience to a completely new level and set new standards not only for the company, but for the industry as a whole.

recalls.summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2018 E 400 4MATIC Sedan, E 400 4MATIC Wagon, E 400 4MATIC Cabriolet, E 400 4MATIC Coupe, 2018-2020 Maybach S 560 4MATIC, S 560 4MATIC Coupe, S 450 4MATIC, 2019-2020 E 450 4MATIC Sedan, E 450 4MATIC Wagon, E 450 4MATIC Coupe, and E 450 4MATIC Cabriolet vehicles. The drive shaft universal joint may break, resulting in a sudden loss of drive power.
recalls.consequence: A sudden loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the drive shaft as necessary, free of charge. Interim letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, were mailed May 22, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the remedy is available. Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning April 10, 2026.

recalls.summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2022-2025 S-Class, EQE SUV, EQE, EQS SUV and EQS vehicles. Please see the recall report for a complete list of models. Software in the Acoustic Vehicle Alerting System (AVAS) may cause an incorrect external pedestrian warning sound while reversing. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 141, "Minimum Sound Requirements for Hybrid Electric Vehicles."
recalls.consequence: A vehicle that makes an incorrect sound may fail to alert pedestrians of a reversing vehicle, increasing the risk of crash.
recalls.remedy: Dealers will update the AVAS software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 1, 2025. Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372. MBUSA's number for this recall is 2025070005.

issues.title: Manufacturer communication: dual-clutch transmission
issues.cause: XENTRY (MERCEDES):  DUE TO AN OVERFILL OF TRANSMISSION OIL, FROM FACTORY, DUAL CLUTCH TRANSMISSION IS LEAKING AND RUNNING DOWN TRANSMISSION HOUSING.  MODEL 2014 SLAG AMES, ROADSTER. | Complaint Intermittent shift feel or thud/clunk noise perceived, such as a brief jerk or transmission reaction during certain driving situations. May be most noticeable when transitioning from a coasting condition to accelerator pedal application. May occur in all drive modes. Cause Dualclutch transmissions (DCT) inherently exhibit more dynamic shifting behavior compared to other types of transmissions. This is due to the use of physical clutches for starting and gear changes. In certain situations, dynamic driving behavior can lead to a slight jerk sensation which is a normal technical characteristic of the transmission. A typical example is a "Change of Mind" situation:  The customer is coasting towards a red traffic light.  The traffic light turns green while the vehicle is still coasting.  The customer then presses the accelerator pedal. In these situations, a slight jerk may occur briefly because the transmission must quickly engage the appropriate gear and control the clutches accordingly. Since shift forks are responsible for engaging the gears during shifting, a slight shifting noise may also be noticeable. Please note driving programs S, S+, and M are designed to provide sportier vehicle behavior and are not optimized primarily for maximum comfort, so this operation may be more audible. Remedy Verify the customer's concern and confirm proper transmission operation. If no faults or abnormal operating conditions are identified by IPR (Intelligent Predictive Repair), no hardware replacement is necessary. Inform the customer that the transmission has been designed to provide direct gear engagement and responsive vehicle performance. Under certain operating conditions, brief shift sensations may be perceptible and are consistent with the operating characteristics of the dualclutch

issues.title: Manufacturer communication: pre-collision false braking
issues.cause: Complaint General information on the operation of the PRE-SAFE Impulse system: The PRE-SAFE Side Impulse system is a preventive, i.e. pre-collision occupant protection system. The task of the system is to provide additional protection to vehicle occupants when there is a risk of a side impact. It is not a restraint system component in the conventional sense and does not contain an detonator. A potential side-impact situation is detected by radar sensors. If the system detects an existing likelihood of a side impact, a reversible air cushion in the outer seat side bolster is briefly inflated by opening a valve. The resulting pulse preemptively increases the distance between the door and the occupant in order to move the occupant out of the danger zone. If the system has been activated, the following message appears on the instrument cluster: PRE-SAFE Side Impulse inoperative. See Operator's Manual. Note: After system activation, diagnostic entry B1B3713 or B1B3813 is marked as active and stored in the ORC223 (N2/5) control unit. Cause After activation of the PRE-SAFE Side Impulse system, the function is no longer available. Remedy Please check the tight seating and possible damage of the radar sensors B29/11 or B29/12. Then replace the gas generator on the affected side (R12/65 or R12/66). After replacing the gas generator (R12/65 or R12/66), please perform commissioning and SCN coding of the radar sensors B29/11 or B29/12 to ensure they are up to date. Note: In principle, it is not necessary to replace the air cushion in the "PRE-SAFE Side Impulse" system, as it is designed for multiple activations (up to 10). Exception: After deployment of the sidebag (e.g., following a crash), exchange (air cushion with gas generator) of the "PRE-SAFE  Impulse Side" is required in all cases.

Complaint Intermittent shift feel or thud/clunk noise perceived, such as a brief jerk or transmission reaction during certain driving situations. May be most noticeable when transitioning from a coasting condition to accelerator pedal application. May occur in all drive modes. Cause Dualclutch transmissions (DCT) inherently exhibit more dynamic shifting behavior compared to other types of transmissions. This is due to the use of physical clutches for starting and gear changes. In certain situations, dynamic driving behavior can lead to a slight jerk sensation which is a normal technical characteristic of the transmission. A typical example is a "Change of Mind" situation:  The customer is coasting towards a red traffic light.  The traffic light turns green while the vehicle is still coasting.  The customer then presses the accelerator pedal. In these situations, a slight jerk may occur briefly because the transmission must quickly engage the appropriate gear and control the clutches accordingly. Since shift forks are responsible for engaging the gears during shifting, a slight shifting noise may also be noticeable. Please note driving programs S, S+, and M are designed to provide sportier vehicle behavior and are not optimized primarily for maximum comfort, so this operation may be more audible. Remedy Verify the customer's concern and confirm proper transmission operation. If no faults or abnormal operating conditions are identified by IPR (Intelligent Predictive Repair), no hardware replacement is necessary. Inform the customer that the transmission has been designed to provide direct gear engagement and responsive vehicle performance. Under certain operating conditions, brief shift sensations may be perceptible and are consistent with the operating characteristics of the dualclutch transmission

Complaint Only vehicles with a variable transfer case are affected. This can be identified through control unit N45 or N15/7 in the quick test. When accelerating with light load, vibrations or jolting sensation may come from the drivetrain. It may be mistaken for a harsh shift. Cause Modified oil quality of the transfer case over time Remedy 1. Check initial quick test for faults in the following control units. N45 or N15/7 - All-wheel drive (ARS) N127 - 'Drivetrain' (PTCU) control unit Y3/8 - Transmission control for 9-gear transmission (VGS) N3/10 - Engine electronics for combustion engine If faults are present: Process them as per the guided test in Xentry. If no faults are present: 2. Check the transmission oil level If the oil level is correct: 3. Unplug the connector for the transfer cases control unit and reassess the vehicle on a subsequent test drive If the complaint no longer occurs with the control unit disconnected: 4. Perform an oil change of the transfer case according to WIS specifications - Collect an oil sample of the original fluid 5. Complete all transfer case Tech-in processes located under VG Control Unit > Adaptations - Resetting the oil service data - Calibration of N15/7 5. Perform road test of vehicle to bring transmission to operating temperature ( >60C ) 6. Operate vehicle in full circle with steering at full lock - 5x to the left - 5x to the right 7. Perform an extended 200mi road test to ensure the clutches are properly conditioned with the new oil. 8. Reassess the concern and release the vehicle if no longer present. If the concern continues to occur with the control unit disconnected or after the above steps have been performed, please submit a TIPS case to the Powertrain inbox with the following information: - Initial quick test with fault freeze frame data - Initial transmission EEPROM data - VGS and Transfer Case Control Unit Log (N45 or N15/7) - Photo of the original oil condition - What color was the fluid drained from the transfer case before the oil change? - Was an oil sample collected, and can you provide a photo of the original fluid? - What color and part number fluid was used during the oil change? - How far was the vehicle driven after?
